verdict.rationale: Brex's own Transactions API lets you programmatically read transactions, accounts, and statements (brex-docs-4), giving a first-party path to pull core financial data out. Brex's docs also show a Zapier recipe that exports card transactions to CSV (brex-docs-31), but that relies on a third-party tool rather than a native export. Nothing documents a complete, self-serve export of all account data (expenses, receipts, bills, users, policies) in open formats for offboarding. Missing for 10: native bulk full-account export, coverage of all data types beyond transactions/statements, documented open export formats, offboarding/portability guidance, hands-on corroboration.
